items.headline: Etihad Rail Opens Pedestrian Bridge Linking Dubai Stations
items.summary: A new 375-meter pedestrian bridge now connects Dubai Al Yalayis Station directly to Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station. The project improves transit access for passengers in the area.
items.why: It enhances local connectivity and public transit access for residents near Jumeirah Golf Estates.
items.impact_reason: Improves local transport connectivity and community accessibility.

bullets: On Wednesday 14 October, Dubai recorded 606 sales worth AED 1.5bn, which is 34.9% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 70.5% of sales, compared to a 7-day average of 63.5%.
The median price per square foot was 1,676 AED, up 1.6% over the last 30 days and down 1.0% from last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were Dubai South (DWC) with 288 sales, JVC with 204 sales, and Downtown Jebel Ali with 150 sales.
In September new rental contracts for a 1-bedroom apartment in JVC had a median of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: Abu Dhabi has detailed seven foreigner categories for the Golden Visa, which directly influences buyer demand and foreign investment in UAE property.
Sharjah recorded $12.74 billion in property deals, highlighting strong investor demand and high rental yields in a neighboring emirate.
Aldar entered the Sharjah market through a $300 million Arada partnership, showing shifting regional investment patterns among major developers.
